مُفَرَّكٌ [Caused to be hated, or to be much hated: see its verb. And] A man hated by women: (S, O, K:) such was Imra-el-Keys: (S, O:) [and accord. to Freytag, ↓ مَفْرُوكٌ occurs in this sense in the Deewán of Jereer.] And مُفَرَّكَةٌ A woman hated by men. (IAar, K.) ―
-b2- Also Left, forsaken, or abandoned, and hated. (Fr, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
